MONDELLO V3 / CONNECTED NEURONS

Recorded activation replay. Weights stay fixed; node activity changes. 90 real snapshots.

64 image features + normalised speed ->16 ReLU features ->steering. Blue/red edges = positive/negative actual weights. Width = absolute weight. Node intensity uses fixed recorded scales. Output colour uses absolute steering magnitude; its signed value is shown. Biases are included in numerical verification but are not drawn. This is the dense head; the convolutional encoder is collapsed.
